messages:
maira (release-manager): RC created: candidate build 2026.03.21-rc7 (sha: a1b2c3d). Ready for QA / sign-off. Change window: 2026-03-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Can we do a quick rollcall? @deploy-bot run smoke

deploy-bot: Build artifact a1b2c3d uploaded. Smoke tests started -> 22 passed, 1 flaky, 0 failed. Canary job queued: canary-rc7-1

juniper (qa): saw a flaky in tokenizer integration on canary-rc7-1: job 1234. Repro locally, investigating. Might be related to recent quantize change.

sahil (eng-lead): Thanks Juniper. If flaky is infra-related we can still promote with canary gating + abort on regression. What's the severity? @ops-sheriff?

juniper (qa): Low severity for now, but fails ~1/10 runs. Steps to reproduce in thread below. I'm rerunning smoke now.

deploy-bot: Smoke rerun complete: all 23 tests passed. Canary canary-rc7-1 healthy for 5m. Metrics: latency +0.5ms, error rate 0.01% -> OK

alex (infra): Reminder: there's a schema migration in this RC (migrations/20260321_reshard.sql). If we promote, set migration flag `db.migrate=true` in deploy config and schedule 5-min maintenance window.

maira (release-manager): Good catch. We will set the migration flag. Ops-sheriff, can you standby for the migration run and rollback plan? We want a guarded promote: 10% traffic for 15m -> 50% -> 100%

ops-sheriff: I'll be oncall and ready. Rollback plan: if 5xx > 0.5% or median latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, abort and revert to sha: z9y8x7w. I'll pin revert artifact now.

maira (release-manager): Pinned revert artifact z9y8x7w to 'release/previous' tag. Release notes: include db migration steps + known flaky tokenizer test. I'll post PR to release-notes shortly.

sahil (eng-lead): lgtm from eng. Approving timed promote. @deploy-bot schedule promote at 2026-03-21T22:05:00Z with rollout plan: steps = ['10% for 15m','50% for 10m','100%'] and max_in_flight=2

deploy-bot: /promote --artifact a1b2c3d --at 2026-03-21T22:05:00Z --plan '10:15,50:10,100:0' --flags 'db.migrate=true' --max-in-flight 2

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: job id promo-rc7-20260321-01. Canary started 22:05Z. Notifications will post here. To cancel: /promote cancel promo-rc7-20260321-01

juniper (qa): I'll watch canary metrics and do quick eval of QA prompts at 22:10Z. ping me if any anomalies :eyes:

maira (release-manager): :thumbsup: all set. Thanks team. I'll follow release-notes PR and do the release readout after 100%.
